cause_quote: The relocated plugin path calls `resolveModelHeaderSentinels` at construction and stream handoff, and its `const headers = resolveAiTransportHeaderSentinels(model.headers);` line limits model credential resolution to visible headers.
user_saw: Plugin-backed title or summary generation could fail because the provider received an unresolved credential placeholder.
summary: The fix adds a host hook that resolves visible model headers and attached request credentials before plugin stream construction and handoff.
reasoning: In the causing commit's parent, simple completions called `registerProviderStreamForModel`, which invoked the full-model resolver at both plugin boundaries. I checked that the parent resolver handled symbol-attached request headers, bearer tokens, and custom auth-header values, and that the relocation replaced those calls with a helper that reads only `model.headers`.
